text:
Sara: Heads-up — doing a small traffic-nudge / leapfrog rollout tonight across EU -> APAC edges. Goal: move a subset of latency-sensitive routes to eu-edge-2 and ap-sg-edge without global blips. Starting window 00:30 UTC, ~5% initial. Pls read plan + ack if you own any of the steps.

Raj: I can own the route policy change and rollback. Which policies are we touching?

Sara: Route groups: `latency-sensitive-v1` and `chat-short-p99` (only those). We'll do: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m observation per step. Leapfrog: after eu-edge-2 reaches 50% we'll nudge ap-sg-edge to 5% then ramp.

Olivia: Who's deploying the edge nodes config? I can do the cert reload + health checks for eu-edge-2.

Mike: I'll handle the ap-sg-edge config push and chip in on smoke metrics.

DeployBot: release:route-policy v2026.3.4 queued by Sara — will annotate when applied.

Sara: Quick checklist:
- Owner for route change: Raj @Raj
- Edge config push: Olivia (eu) / Mike (ap)
- Observability: Dave to watch SLO dashboards and alert on p50/p95/p99 and 5xx rate
- Rollback command (route policy): `rctl routeset --policy latency-sensitive-v1 --set-weight-file previous_weights.json`
- DNS soft-ttl tweak: lower to 60s in advance (Olivia can apply at -30m)

Raj: Confirmed. I'll stage the policy JSON now. Will put the canary weights script in `/ops/deploys/traffic-nudge/` and share snippet.

Raj: Snippet: ```bash
# apply 5% to eu-edge-2
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  https://control-plane/routing/api/v1/set_weights \
  -d '{"policy":"latency-sensitive-v1","targets":[{"region":"eu-edge-2","weight":5}]}'
```

Olivia: Doing DNS TTL change at -30m: ```bash
cloud-dns update-zone --zone redwood-prod --record 'app.redwood.example.com' --ttl 60
```

Mike: Smoke checks to run after each step:
- `GET /healthz` should be 200
- p99 generation latency < 250ms (for these routes)
- no >2x increase in 5xx rate for 5m window
- no surprise error spikes in inference queues

Dave: I'll attach the alert runbook to the thread. If p99 > 350ms or 5xx rate spikes > 1% we roll back immediately.

Sara: Escalation: if rollback needed, Raj executes route rollback and Olivia/Mike revert edge config if we see config-related failures. Notify #oncall and #sre-runbooks.

Olivia: Pre-warm note: spin up an extra 2 nodes on eu-edge-2 at -15m to warm model caches. `gcloud compute instances start --count 2 --tags edge-cache-warm`

Mike: ACK. I'll watch ap-sg logs during leapfrog and run quick `dig` checks after DNS TTL flip: `dig +short @1.1.1.1 app.redwood.example.com` to ensure vips resolve to expected edges.

Raj: I'll post the exact weight files and a one-liner rollback command when I'm ready. ETA 00:10 UTC.

Sara: Thanks. Plan timeline summary:
- 00:00 UTC: lower DNS TTL to 60 (Olivia)
- 00:15 UTC: warm edge nodes (Olivia/Mike)
- 00:30 UTC: apply 5% eu-edge-2 (Raj)
- 00:40 UTC: observe 10m -> if OK, 20%
- 00:50 UTC: observe -> 50%
- 01:10 UTC: leapfrog start to ap-sg-edge 5% and follow same ramp
- 02:00 UTC: target 100% for both policies if healthy

Dave: I'll post quick links to the dashboards at start and keep a running note of any anomalies.

DeployBot: route-policy v2026.3.4: applied policy stub at 00:30 UTC (simulated).

Olivia: TTL lowered to 60s ✅

Raj: 5% applied to eu-edge-2 ✅

Mike: Initial smoke after 5% looks clean, p99s stable, no 5xx blips.

Sara: Nice. Continue ramps as planned. If anyone sees anything odd, call a pause and tag here. :thumbsup:

Dave: small transient spike in queue latency at 00:36 UTC but back to baseline by 00:38 — watching.

Mike: 20% -> 50% applied, no regressions.

Raj: Leapfrog to ap-sg-edge started, 5% now.

Olivia: ap-sg-edge cert reload done, health checks passing.

Dave: No alert triggers so far. P95 trending down a bit.

Sara: Final ramp to 100% scheduled at 01:50 UTC if all green. Otherwise we hold.

Raj: Rollback command ready in ops folder if needed.

Olivia: Holding on final 100% for 10m to confirm stability.

Mike: ACK holding.

Sara: Thanks everyone — great coordination. Will close thread after final 100% or if we hit any rollbacks. :party:
